text_block_list.text: The day of the Sprinters Stakes—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I am fully prepared. If I were to lose 
here, surpassing the "Emperor of the Mile" 
would remain nothing more than a distant 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I will surely achieve victory and make the 
tempest rage.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin Bakushiiin! Oh, if it isn't 
Zephyr-san!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-san. Thank you for all your 
help at the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
No thanks are necessary!! For thanks to 
those days, I have attained even greater 
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin means, in other words, an 
explosive rush of mind, body, and spirit!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I will not lose to the 
roaring wind!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Ever the eccentric, as always.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us settle it here and now. 
Between you and me, who is the fiercer 
gale?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san...! Um—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I won't lose today!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san... Today, you seem to carry 
not only a gentle breeze of blossoms, but 
a fierce, powerful wind as well."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Running with Zephyr-san so much during the 
training camp... It made me think over and 
over again what an amazing older sister 
figure she is.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's why...! I want to defeat 
you. In a fair, head-on match!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Because I think showing courage to 
everyone means doing something like 
this...!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...It is as though a heavenly wind has 
blown. I am truly, exceedingly blessed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Both Bakushin O-san and Flower-san compete 
against me with the spirit of a true 
tempest.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That is why I shall become it. Swallowing 
all of it whole—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Run swift, run fierce, as a raging gale!
